ranked_suspects.mechanism: Doubles dynamic LDS (sh8 = 8*(n_embd/32)*36 B + res[8][64]) and accumulator registers (s0[8], s1[8]) in native_gu_fused_kernel and native_down_lds_kernel across all 48 MoE layers for every T>=2 window, halving CU occupancy on gfx1201 while solo T=2..8 windows mostly route 1-3 tokens per expert.

Replaces tuned native_mmvq / native_mmvq_il kernels with wmma_q8_0_kernel / wmma_q8_0_segs_kernel / wmma_q6_k_kernel whenever ncols >= 9 (T=10,12,14,16 lookup-chain windows). Directly measured in docs/ab/perf-verify-wide-results-2026-11-19.md (Arm 1+2 vs Arm 1) to regress R9700 throughput by -5.7%.

Caps gridDim.y of native_gu_fused_kernel<TG,8>, native_down_lds_kernel<TG,8>, and CUDA-layout MoE kernels to 64 instead of cap_groups. When a T=8..16 window routes >64 distinct experts in a layer, blocks 0..(n_groups-65) execute a second serial loop iteration with __syncthreads() while the rest sit idle.

Skips missed experts at rank 6 (in addition to 7..9 from STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=7) when only speculative draft tokens route them (!any_anchor_row), degrading draft-row logits and contributing to the draft acceptance median drop from 53.4-54.0% (Eras 197-198) to 50.0% (Era 200).
